dedupe_keys.name: climada app eiopa desktop interface for climada natural catastrophe and climate risk assessment

description: CLIMADA-App is a free desktop application from the European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority that puts a user-friendly interface on CLIMADA, the open-source catastrophe and climate risk model developed at ETH Zurich. It targets small and medium insurers and national supervisors: users pick default LitPop exposure or import their own at point, NUTS region or country level, the app disaggregates to coordinates, runs hazard, exposure and impact calculations and aggregates results back to regions and countries for download as Excel or PDF. The June 2026 release adds European-level multi-peril assessment with diversification, non-additive metrics such as return period losses at EEA level, forward-looking climate scenarios and new coastal flood, earthquake and wildfire scenarios. Coverage is Europe. Format and access: a Windows desktop app and its source code, sent after a free registration form, with a documentation PDF. Licence: GPL-3.0 for CLIMADA as quoted on the page, plus EIOPA's disclaimer; free. Caveats: EIOPA takes no responsibility for model or data accuracy and does not guarantee compatibility with future CLIMADA versions. It brings natural hazard exposure and climate adaptation analysis of insured assets within reach of non-specialists. Related catalogue records are CLIMADA and the CLIMADA LitPop exposure data.
